summary: Frontend-only verification of Landing dark-theme fix. Homepage now renders correctly in dark mode with legible white headings. All CTAs route to /login, images load, anchors scroll, and dashboard regression is unaffected.

issues: Anchor links (#how/#features/#dealers) scroll target to top: 0 which is under the fixed 64px nav — section headings sit slightly behind the fixed nav. Minor. Consider scroll-margin-top: 5rem on sections.

verification_details.cta_navigation: nav-signup, nav-signin, hero-signup-button, hero-signin-button, dealers-signup-button, footer-signup-button, footer-signin-link — all navigate to /login ✓
verification_details.anchor_scroll: How it works / Features / For dealerships all scroll into view
verification_details.dashboard_regression: Login with admin@autoacquire.ai / Admin123! → /app/dashboard renders in dark theme (bg rgb(10,10,11)), data (Hot leads, KPIs, New leads) loads normally

critical_code_review_comments: The .dark class is applied only on the Landing root div (not on <html>/<body>), so document.body remains rgb(250,250,250). Not a bug for the landing, but be aware if any absolutely/fixed-positioned overlay renders outside the .dark subtree (e.g. portals for toasts/modals) — they will render in light theme. Consider toggling .dark on <html> globally or in a ThemeProvider to be safe.
Anchor targets lack scroll-margin-top to compensate for the fixed 64px nav — section headings can sit under the nav after clicking anchor links.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing dark-theme fix verified end-to-end. Only minor cosmetic note: anchor links don't offset for fixed nav. Dashboard unaffected.
